e.title: **一个**把**保单现金流**当成**有向无环图**来**算的**精算估值平台****：`actura-valuation-platform`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**enterprise-grade actuarial platform that bridges the gap between complex risk mathematics and modern UI/UX**」**；**⭐ 一条**建模口径**逐字**为**「**Nodes represent financial events (e.g. premium collection, mortality decrements, expense payouts)**」**，**而**「**Edges dictate the flow of policyholder states and cash across the timeline**」**；**⭐ 蓝图**逐字**以 **JSON** 存库、**由 **Python** 引擎**按**投影时步**执行****；**⭐ 内置指标**逐字含 **BEL、**VaR 95%、**CVaR／CTE 95** 与 **IFRS 17** 的 **CSM 机制****；**⚠️ 仓库**无许可证**
e.title_en: An actuarial valuation platform that evaluates policy cash flows as a directed acyclic graph: it describes itself in writing as an enterprise-grade platform bridging complex risk mathematics and modern user experience, states that graph nodes represent financial events such as premium collection, mortality decrements, and expense payouts while edges dictate the flow of policyholder states and cash across the timeline, stores the blueprint as structured data executed by a Python engine over projection steps, and builds in measures including a best estimate of liabilities, value at risk, conditional tail expectation, and contractual service margin mechanics for the international reporting standard.

e.summary_en: This is an actuarial valuation platform that evaluates policy cash flows as a directed acyclic graph, describing itself in writing as an actuarial valuation and risk platform. **Measured this round**: created in late August and last pushed on the ninth of September, a repository of about seventeen megabytes in Python, no stars, no licence file, a main branch, and a description of about five kilobytes over one hundred three lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of adjudicating the items earlier rounds had parked for review**, because this round first probed three new surfaces, a website plugin directory, an organisation account axis, and repository-name-only search, all of which measured as nearly empty, and therefore switched to clearing the parked backlog. **Four things are worth reading: cash flows are modelled as a graph rather than written as a loop, with nodes representing financial events such as premium collection, mortality decrements, and expense payouts, and edges carrying policyholder states and cash along the timeline; the blueprint is separated from the engine, since the front end compiles the graph into structured data stored in the database while a Python engine executes it over projection steps; built-in measures include a best estimate of liabilities, value at risk, conditional tail expectation, and contractual service margin mechanics with risk adjustment tracking for the international reporting standard; and the drag-and-drop editor is described in writing as designing cash flow blueprints without writing code, which this entry flags as precisely the place where auditability of a graphical model needs the most care.** **The platform was neither deployed nor run this round.**
e.body:
**Actura**（`Rytsia1/Actura`）**是一个**把**保单现金流**建成**有向无环图**来**估值的**精算平台****——**逐字自述为**「**Actuarial Valuation & Risk Platform**」**，**并**逐字自称**「**enterprise-grade actuarial platform that bridges the gap between complex risk mathematics and modern UI/UX**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**把此前各轮记为「**待评**」的条目**逐条判定**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 现金流被建成「**图**」**，**而**不**是**写成**一段**循环****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Actura evaluates insurance cash flows as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG).**」**，**并逐字给出**两句话**的**语义**：**「**Nodes represent financial events (e.g. premium collection, mortality decrements, expense payouts).**」**与**「**Edges dictate the flow of policyholder states and cash across the timeline.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**本条**最值得记**的**设计选择**：**⭐ 即**把**「**模型结构**」**外化成**一张**可**保存、**可**展示、**可**逐节点**讨论的**图**，**而**不**把**它**藏**在**几千行**代码**里**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**当**你**要**向**非技术**的**评审**解释**一个**现金流模型**时**，**一张**节点图**通常**比**一段**代码**有效**得多**；**⭐ 而**代价**是**：**必须**额外**证明**「**图上**画的**」**与**「**引擎**算的**」**一致**。

**⭐⭐ ② 蓝图与引擎分离：**图**进库、**引擎**按时步**执行****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**The graph is compiled by the Vue 3 frontend, saved as a JSON blueprint to the database, and executed by the Python actuarial engine over projection timesteps.**」**；**⭐ 架构逐字为四层**：**前端 **Vue 3（**图交互用 **Vue Flow、**图表用 **ECharts）**、**后端 **FastAPI**、**数据库 **PostgreSQL（**经 **SQLAlchemy**，**存**项目、**蓝图与**随机结果）**、**反向代理 **Nginx****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一分工**对**精算**很**贴切**：**⭐ 即**「**蓝图**」**是**业务语言**（**保费、**给付、**减因），**而**「**引擎**」**是**数值实现**（**投影时步、**情景）**——**⭐ 两者**分开**之后**，**同一张**蓝图**可以**换**引擎**重算**，**而**引擎**可以**被**单独**测试**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 内置指标覆盖**负债、**尾部风险与**新准则****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**功能逐字列出**：**随机引擎**（**逐字**：**Integrated Economic Scenario Generators (ESG) and advanced Monte Carlo simulations**）**、**风险分析**（**逐字**：**BEL, VaR 95%, CVaR / CTE 95, and quantile fan-charts**）**、**新准则**（**逐字**：**IFRS 17 Ready: Automated CSM (Contractual Service Margin) mechanics and Risk Adjustment tracking**）**、**容器化**（**逐字**：**Docker-Ready** 并含 **Nginx** 反向代理）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**这些**是**声明**支持**的**指标**，**而**不是**已**验证**的**结果**——**⚠️ 本次**未运行**任何一次**估值**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 一处**必须**点名的**风险面**：**可视建模**的**可审计性****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字把**拖拽编辑器**描述为**「**a visual, node-based DAG editor for designing insurance cash flow blueprints without writing code**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一点**值得**单独**提示**：**⭐ 即**「**不写代码**」**降低**了**上手**门槛**，**但**同时**把**「**模型逻辑**」**搬进**了**点击**序列**——**⭐ 若**没有**蓝图**版本**、**变更**记录**与**审批**痕迹**，**则**「**这次**结果**是**哪一张**图**算出来的**」**会**变**得**难以**回答**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**凡**用**可视**建模**，**都**要**先**回答**「**蓝图**怎么**版本化**、**谁**批过**」**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[vates-actuarial-engine]] 与 **[[arcrho-reserving-platform]] 覆盖**精算引擎**与**准备金平台**、**[[ifrs17-calculation-engine]] 覆盖**新准则**计算引擎**、**[[detlifeinsurance]] 覆盖**确定性**寿险**计算**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**节点图**为**建模单位**、**并**把**蓝图**存库**再由**引擎**执行**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **把**模型结构**外化成**可讨论的**图**；**② **蓝图**与**引擎**分离**，**各自**可**替换**；**③ **尾部风险**（**CVaR／CTE）与**负债**最好**（BEL）要**同时**给**；**④ **新准则**的**负债**与**风险调整**要**分别**跟踪**；**⑤ **可视**建模**必须**配**版本化**与**审批**；**⑥ **容器化**与**反代**是**交付**门槛**，**而**不是**加分项**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有部署、**没有运行**该平台**（**未起 **FastAPI**、**未建 **PostgreSQL**、**未跑**任何 **Monte Carlo** 或 **IFRS 17** 计算）**，**故**不主张**其**任何指标**的**数值正确性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **Python** 与 **Vue** 源码**、**未读**其架构文档**。**③ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**——**⚠️ 本词条**如实指出**：**「**自称**企业级**」**与**「**已授予使用许可**」**是**两件事**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**IFRS 17** 实现**是否**符合**准则**（**⭐ 逐字**只**说**自动 **CSM 机制**与**风险调整**跟踪**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**经济情景生成器**的**模型**与**校准**来源**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**与**任何**保险公司**或**咨询机构**相关**（**⭐ 星标为 **0**，**且**无组织**归属信息**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该平台**是**计算工具**，**不是**精算意见**，**也**不是**准则合规证明**。

**Actura**（`Rytsia1/Actura`）**是一個**把**保單現金流**建成**有向無環圖**來**估值的**精算平台****——**逐字自述為**「**Actuarial Valuation & Risk Platform**」**，**並逐字自稱**「**enterprise-grade actuarial platform that bridges the gap between complex risk mathematics and modern UI/UX**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**把此前各輪記為「**待評**」的條目**逐條判定**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 現金流建成「**圖**」，**而非寫成一段迴圈****——**逐字**「**Actura evaluates insurance cash flows as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG).**」**，**並逐字給出語義**「**Nodes represent financial events (e.g. premium collection, mortality decrements, expense payouts).**」**與**「**Edges dictate the flow of policyholder states and cash across the timeline.**」**；**⭐ 即**把模型結構外化成可保存、**可展示、**可逐節點討論的圖**，**代價是必須額外證明「**圖上畫的**」與「**引擎算的**」一致**。

**⭐⭐ ② 藍圖與引擎分離****——**逐字**「**The graph is compiled by the Vue 3 frontend, saved as a JSON blueprint to the database, and executed by the Python actuarial engine over projection timesteps.**」**；**架構逐字為**Vue 3（**Vue Flow 與 ECharts）**、**FastAPI、**PostgreSQL（**SQLAlchemy）**、**Nginx**；**⭐ 即**同一張藍圖可換引擎重算**，**引擎可單獨測試**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 內建指標覆蓋負債、**尾部風險與新準則****——**逐字**Integrated Economic Scenario Generators (ESG) and advanced Monte Carlo simulations**、**BEL, VaR 95%, CVaR / CTE 95, and quantile fan-charts**、**IFRS 17 Ready: Automated CSM (Contractual Service Margin) mechanics and Risk Adjustment tracking**、**Docker-Ready**；**⚠️ 這些是聲明支持的指標**，**不是已驗證的結果**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 一處必須點名的風險面：可視建模的可審計性****——**逐字**「**a visual, node-based DAG editor for designing insurance cash flow blueprints without writing code**」**；**⭐ 即**「**不寫代碼**」把模型邏輯搬進點擊序列**——**若**無藍圖版本、**變更記錄與審批痕跡**，**則**「**這次結果是哪一張圖算的**」**難以回答**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[vates-actuarial-engine]]、[[arcrho-reserving-platform]]、[[ifrs17-calculation-engine]]、[[detlifeinsurance]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**以節點圖為建模單位、**藍圖存庫再由引擎執行**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **模型結構外化成圖**；**② **藍圖與引擎分離**；**③ **尾部風險與負債同時給**；**④ **負債與風險調整分別跟蹤**；**⑤ **可視建模配版本化與審批**；**⑥ **容器化與反代是交付門檻**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有部署、**沒有運行**該平台**，**不主張**其任何指標的數值正確性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本**，**未讀**其 Python 與 Vue 源碼**。**③ ⚠️ 該倉庫無許可證檔案**——**「**自稱企業級**」與「**已授予使用許可**」是兩件事**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其 IFRS 17 實現是否符合準則**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其經濟情景生成器的模型與校準來源**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否與任何保險公司或諮詢機構相關**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該平台是計算工具**，**不是**精算意見**，**也**不是**準則合規證明**。

e.body_en:
This is an actuarial valuation platform that evaluates policy cash flows as a directed acyclic graph, describing itself as an actuarial valuation and risk platform and, in its own words, as an enterprise-grade platform bridging complex risk mathematics and modern user experience. **This entry belongs to the round theme of adjudicating the items earlier rounds had parked for review.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, cash flows are modelled as a graph rather than written as a loop.** The description states that the platform evaluates insurance cash flows as a directed acyclic graph, and gives the semantics in two sentences: nodes represent financial events such as premium collection, mortality decrements, and expense payouts, while edges dictate the flow of policyholder states and cash across the timeline. **Externalising the model structure into a graph that can be saved, shown, and discussed node by node, rather than burying it in thousands of lines of code, is the most transferable choice here, because a node diagram usually explains a cash flow model to a non-technical reviewer far better than a code excerpt does, at the cost of having to demonstrate separately that what the graph shows and what the engine computes agree.**

**Second, the blueprint and the engine are separated.** The description states that the graph is compiled by the front end, saved as structured blueprint data in the database, and executed by the Python engine over projection steps. **The stated architecture is a single-page front end handling graph interaction and charting, a Python interface service, a relational database storing projects, blueprints, and stochastic results, and a reverse proxy. Blueprint and engine separate cleanly into business language such as premiums, benefits, and decrements on one side and numerical implementation such as projection steps and scenarios on the other, so one blueprint can be recomputed on another engine and the engine can be tested on its own.**

**Third, the built-in measures span liabilities, tail risk, and the international reporting standard.** The feature list names integrated economic scenario generators with Monte Carlo simulation, measures including a best estimate of liabilities, value at risk at ninety-five percent, conditional tail expectation, and quantile fan charts, automated contractual service margin mechanics with risk adjustment tracking, and containerisation with a reverse proxy. **These are claimed capabilities rather than verified results, since no valuation was run this round.**

**Fourth, one risk surface must be named: the auditability of graphical modelling.** The description calls the editor a visual node-based tool for designing cash flow blueprints without writing code. **Removing code lowers the barrier to entry while moving model logic into a sequence of clicks, so without blueprint versioning, change records, and approval traces, the question of which diagram produced a given result becomes hard to answer.** **For any graphical modelling exercise, how the blueprint is versioned and who approved it should be settled first.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover actuarial engines, a reserving platform, an accounting-standard calculation engine, and deterministic life calculations, **while this entry supplies the form in which a node graph is the modelling unit, stored as a blueprint and executed by an engine. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: externalise model structure into a discussable graph; separate blueprint from engine so each can be replaced; report liabilities and tail risk together; track the liability estimate and its risk adjustment separately; pair graphical modelling with versioning and approval; and treat containerisation and a reverse proxy as delivery requirements rather than extras.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the platform was neither deployed nor run**, no service was started, no database was created, and no simulation or standard-specific calculation was executed, **so no claim is made about the numerical correctness of any measure**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the Python or front-end source and not the architecture document. **Third, the repository carries no licence file**, and **describing itself as enterprise-grade is a different thing from granting a licence to use it**. **Fourth, whether its standard-specific implementation conforms to the accounting standard was not verified**, the description only claiming automated margin mechanics and risk adjustment tracking. **Fifth, the model and calibration behind the scenario generator were not verified.
